purpose: Freeze implementation mechanics for the prospective CALM risk-compression confirmation so later execution cannot tune mechanics after seeing unseen outcomes.

prospective_boundary.rule: Reject all rows with signal_date <= 2026-09-09 from confirmatory statistics before any outcome aggregation.

date_state_construction.joint_calendar: Use the prospectively retained official joint A-share trading calendar authority; no future date may define an earlier state.
date_state_construction.market_ratio: rv10/rv60 from benchmark daily log returns ending at D, ddof=0
date_state_construction.unknown_warmup: Dates lacking the full 60-return benchmark window are UNKNOWN and excluded from H1/H2 confirmation.

stock_factor_construction.rv10_over_rv60: stock rv10/rv60 from daily log source-close returns through D only, ddof=0
stock_factor_construction.tr10_over_tr60: mean true-range-percent over latest 10 valid stock bars divided by mean true-range-percent over latest 60 valid stock bars through D only
stock_factor_construction.finite_positive_requirements: All denominator inputs required by the frozen factor definition must be finite and strictly positive; otherwise factor is missing and never imputed.

outcome_construction.endpoint_rule: For every evaluated D, D and T endpoint prices must come from the same retained T-vintage snapshot.

daily_cross_section.eligible_stock_row: PIT-authorized official-universe row, vendor-stable under the applicable source contract, finite factor, finite D/T economic outcome.
daily_cross_section.rank_ic: Pearson correlation of within-date average ranks of factor and forward return.
daily_cross_section.direction_adjusted_ic: -1 * raw rank IC for both H1 and H2.

bootstrap.calm_ic_null: Center the CALM direction-adjusted daily IC series by subtracting its observed mean; bootstrap centered series; one-sided p=(1+count(null_bootstrap_mean>=observed_mean))/(B+1).
bootstrap.contrast_series: For inference on CALM minus STRESSED strength, construct state-specific date series and bootstrap each state's date series independently with the frozen hypothesis contrast seed split deterministically into CALM seed=contrast_seed and STRESSED seed=contrast_seed+10000; contrast replicate = calm_boot_mean - stressed_boot_mean.
bootstrap.contrast_ci: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of bootstrap contrast replicates.

multiplicity.input_p_values: one-sided centered CALM D+10 direction-adjusted IC p-values

quarter_stability.leave_one_valid_quarter_out: Direction-adjusted CALM D+10 mean IC must remain >0 for every valid-quarter omission.

result_states.V2_8_3_INCOMPLETE_NO_DECISION: Minimum information gate not met; retain contract unchanged and do not emit PASS/FAIL.
result_states.V2_8_3_ARCHITECTURE_CONFIRMED: Both H1 and H2 satisfy every frozen hypothesis PASS condition.
result_states.V2_8_3_PARTIAL_REPLICATION: Exactly one hypothesis satisfies every frozen PASS condition.
result_states.V2_8_3_ARCHITECTURE_REJECTED: Minimum information gate met and neither hypothesis satisfies every frozen PASS condition.
result_states.V2_8_3_BLOCKED: Source/PIT/endpoint/integrity implementation blocker prevents valid evaluation.

forbidden: No use of signal dates <=2026-09-09 in confirmatory statistics.
No changing CALM threshold from one.
No post-result trend-state split, sector filter, factor transform, horizon change, seed change, block-length change or minimum-count change inside V2.8.3.
No interim PASS based on fewer observations than the information gate.
No Setup, Episode or live-trading authorization from V2.8.3 alone.
